source.title: Arc Minerals reports drill results from Cheyeza East

text:
Arc Minerals reports drill results from Cheyeza East

Arc Minerals said that drilling at the Cheyeza East prospect in North-Western Province intersected 42 metres of copper mineralisation. The company completed 12,000 metres of diamond drilling in 2026.

Arc Minerals and its partner Anglo American plan a second drilling programme in 2027. The company expects to publish a maiden resource estimate for the West Lunga licences in 2027.
